title: CISA Catalog of Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Ahsay AhsayCBS contains a command injection vulnerability that could allow a remote attacker to execute operating system commands.
vulnerabilities.requiredAction: Apply mitigations per vendor instructions, follow applicable BOD 22-01 guidance for cloud services, or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Example Networks ExampleOS SSL-VPN Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: ExampleOS contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the SSL-VPN component.

vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityName: Apache Log4j2 Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.shortDescription: Apache Log4j2 contains a vulnerability where JNDI features do not protect against attacker-controlled endpoints.
